text: Cats are small carnivorous mammals known for agility, retractable claws, and sleeping up to 16 hours a day.
Dogs are loyal domesticated mammals descended from wolves, widely used for companionship, herding, and guarding.
Lions are large social big cats living in prides on African savannas; males have a distinctive mane.
Elephants are the largest land animals, with long trunks, big ears, and tusks, and they live in matriarchal herds.
Horses are fast, strong herbivores domesticated for riding, racing, and farm work.
Birds are feathered vertebrates with wings and beaks; most species can fly and lay eggs in nests.
Camels are desert mammals with humps that store fat, and they can survive long periods without water.
Fish are aquatic animals that breathe through gills and swim using fins in oceans, rivers, and lakes.
